**1) Image 1 — Illustrations & Quality:**
*   **Style Consistency:** Yes, the illustrations (man at the pressing station and woman receiving the garment bag) are consistent in style. They both use a clean, modern, flat-vector aesthetic with a premium feel that matches the brand's professional identity.
*   **Broken Images:** No broken images are visible; all graphics and photos load correctly.

**2) Image 1 — New Sections:**
*   **Visibility & Design:** Yes, all new sections are clearly visible and well-designed:
    *   **Offers Strip:** The strip displaying "10% off your first order," "Hotel guests 10% off + 5%," and "5% off every order with pictures" is prominent and cleanly laid out.
    *   **Pricing/Alterations:** The "Per-item or per-kilogram" pricing grid is comprehensive, organized by category (Shirts, Trousers, Suits, etc.), and looks professional.
    *   **Reviews:** The "Loved by Lagos" section features a testimonial with a star rating and a "Return-as-Received Guarantee" info box, both of which are visually polished and integrated well into the page flow.

**3) Image 2 — Mode of Wash Selector:**
*   **Presence & Options:** **No**, there is **no** "Mode of Wash" selector (Machine Wash / Handwash) visible in this screenshot.
*   **Visual Defects:** There are no visual defects in the current view; the UI for selecting items (Shirt quantity set to 2) and choosing between "Per-item" and "Bulk" services functions correctly, but the specific wash mode selector requested is missing from this step.
